userStories.title: Reconcile final-only text and refuse malformed final-only tool arguments
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Fix findings 8 and 9 in createPiProtocol so text_end delivers any missing text suffix and malformed final-only tool arguments use the existing draining bad-request path instead of emitting a successful empty tool call.

**Motivation** — A stream answering `42` only on the completed item returned empty text with a successful stop and billed usage.

**Approach** — Implement the following Design / Integration verbatim; baselines only locate existing code, and targets govern implementation.

Symbols this feature only reads:

- `packages/nax-ai/src/protocols/tool-args.ts`: `parseToolArgs(raw)` (`""` → `{}`, else `JSON.parse`), `createToolArgAccumulator()` with `append(id, name, delta)` and `take(id)` (returns `undefined` when no delta was appended for the id).
- pi-ai events (`@earendil-works/pi-ai` 1.4.0): `text_delta { contentIndex, delta }`, `text_end { contentIndex, content }`, `toolcall_end { toolCall: { id, name, arguments, argumentsError? } }`.

Symbols this feature changes. Each **Baseline** exists only to locate the code. Implement the **Target**, never the baseline.

- The event loop in `createPiProtocol(...).stream` (`packages/nax-ai/src/protocols/pi-client.ts`).
  - Baseline: `text_delta` yields `{ type: "text-delta", text: event.delta }`; `text_end` is ignored.
  - Target: the stream keeps a per-stream `Map<number, string>` of text emitted per `contentIndex`. `text_delta` appends `event.delta` to its index's entry and yields as today. `text_end` reads the entry for its `contentIndex` (`""` when absent): when `event.content` starts with it and is longer, it yields one `{ type: "text-delta", text: event.content.slice(emitted.length) }`; when `event.content` equals it, or does not start with it, nothing is yielded (text already emitted cannot be retracted). The entry is then removed; entries for blocks that never get a `text_end` are simply dropped with the stream (no flush). The `default:` branch comment that says `text_end` carries nothing is updated.
- `toolcall_end` handling (same file).
  - Baseline: `input = parseToolArgs(pending?.raw ?? "")`, then `completedToolInput(event.toolCall, input)`.
  - Target: when `event.toolCall.argumentsError !== undefined` and no non-empty accumulation exists (`pending === undefined` or `pending.raw === ""`), it sets `malformedToolArgs` to the existing bad-request error (`Tool "<name>" returned unparseable arguments.`, `cause: event.toolCall.argumentsError`) and yields no tool call, exactly like the accumulated-JSON parse failure. The `completedToolInput` doc comment (which says `argumentsError` keeps the accumulation) is updated to name this case. Every other case is unchanged: no `argumentsError` with `arguments` `{}` yields input `{}`; `argumentsError` with a parseable accumulation yields the accumulation.

### Failure Handling

| Case | Behaviour |
|:---|:---|
| `text_end` content diverges from the emitted deltas | Nothing more is emitted for that block; the deltas stand. |
| `argumentsError` with no usable accumulation | Draining continues to the terminal event for usage, then one bad-request error, as for an unparseable accumulation. |

Implementation context: the current package pins pi-ai 1.5.0; the preceding 1.4.0 reference describes the review's event contract, not a request to change the dependency. Keep existing malformed accumulated-JSON failures, completed-tool-object precedence, usage accounting, and retry/abort behavior unchanged.

**Scope** — In: modify only packages/nax-ai/src/protocols/pi-client.ts at runtime, including the two named doc comments; create packages/nax-ai/test/protocols/pi-client-final-text.test.ts for ACs 1-6 and 11 using small local builders; extend packages/nax-ai/test/protocols/pi-client-final-args.test.ts for ACs 7-10 and 12 using its existing argumentsDelta, callEnd(arguments, argumentsError?), and done builders without changing existing assertions. There are no inter-story boundaries because this feature has one story.

**Scope** — Out: Findings 1-7 and 10-13 of review e684f920 belong to the other three review-e684 features (acp-sessions, chat, workflow-verification). Thinking blocks are unchanged; their completed content already comes from `thinking_end`. Reconciling text from the terminal `done` message's content blocks, for a block that never received `text_end`, is not done. The existing test title in `packages/nax-ai/test/protocols/pi-client.test.ts` that says `text_end` is dropped is left as is; its assertion still holds. A `text_end` whose content diverges from the emitted deltas is not reported as an error or warning.

**Interface** — Spec event shapes: `text_delta { contentIndex, delta }`, `text_end { contentIndex, content }`, `toolcall_end { toolCall: { id, name, arguments, argumentsError? } }`. Existing read-only helper interfaces: `parseToolArgs(raw)`, `createToolArgAccumulator()` with `append(id, name, delta)` and `take(id)`. No new public signatures or seams: every AC drives `createPiProtocol(...).stream` or public `createClient(...).complete`. AC 2 must use a ProtocolFactory returning createPiProtocol("openai-responses", ...) over a fake pi stream, with a local provider catalog modeled on test/client.test.ts; do not substitute a fake ProtocolEvent stream for the real adapter. Keep the new text harness self-contained rather than importing fakePi from pi-client.test.ts, which is already over the 800-line limit.

**Validation** — Use tdd-simple: demonstrate every non-control regression fails against the old source before implementing, and preserve all control outcomes. Run focused offline Vitest tests and the package suite plus normal gates from packages/nax-ai. Scripted-event tests do not establish real-provider production frequency.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `text_start` at index 0, `text_end` at index 0 with content `"42"`, and `done`, then it yields exactly one `text-delta` with text `"42"`.

[integration] When `createClient` uses a `ProtocolFactory` whose returned protocol entries register `createPiProtocol("openai-responses", ...)` under the `openai-responses` protocol's `pi` backend over a fake pi stream of `text_start` at index 0, `text_end` at index 0 with content `"42"`, and `done`, with a provider catalog built as in `test/client.test.ts`, then `complete` returns a result whose `text` is `"42"`.

[unit] (control) When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `text_delta` `"he"`, `text_delta` `"llo"`, and `text_end` content `"hello"` at index 0, then it yields exactly the two `text-delta` values `"he"` and `"llo"`, and no other `text-delta`.
[unit] When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `text_delta` `"he"` and `text_end` content `"hello"` at index 0, then its `text-delta` sequence is `"he"` followed by `"llo"`.
[unit] (control) When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `text_delta` `"abc"` and `text_end` content `"xyz"` at index 0, then it yields only the `"abc"` delta.

[unit] When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `text_delta` `"A"` at index 0, `text_end` content `"A"` at index 0, `text_start` at index 1, `text_end` content `"B"` at index 1, and `done`, then it yields `text-delta` `"A"` followed by exactly one `text-delta` `"B"`.

[unit] When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `toolcall_end` with `arguments` `{}`, `argumentsError` `"Tool arguments must be a JSON object"`, and no preceding argument delta, then it yields no `tool-call` event.

[unit] When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `toolcall_end` for `lookup` with `arguments` `{}`, `argumentsError` `"Tool arguments must be a JSON object"`, and no preceding argument delta, followed by `done`, then it ends with a `usage` event followed by one `error` event whose `error.kind` is `bad-request`, `error.message` is `Tool "lookup" returned unparseable arguments.`, and `error.cause` is the `argumentsError` string, as for an unparseable accumulation.
[unit] (control) When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `toolcall_end` with `arguments` `{}`, no `argumentsError`, and no delta, then it yields one `tool-call` whose input is `{}`.

[unit] (control) When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `toolcall_end` with `argumentsError` after the argument delta `{"city":"SG"}`, then it yields one `tool-call` whose input is `{ city: "SG" }`.

[unit] (control) When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `text_delta` `"hello"` and `text_end` content `"he"` at index 0, then it yields only the `"hello"` delta; a lone `text_end` with empty content at index 1 yields no `text-delta`.

[unit] When `createPiProtocol(...).stream` receives `toolcall_end` with `argumentsError` after a single empty-string argument delta (`""`), then it yields no `tool-call` and ends with the `bad-request` error.

routing.reasoning: Three-file bounded bug fix using established stream state, prefix reconciliation, and the existing malformed-tool drain path; no new abstraction, dependency, public API, or security-critical behavior. Offline regression tests can be written first in the same implementation session.

modifiedFiles.reason: the `text_end` reconciliation and the `toolcall_end` bad-request branch, plus the two doc comments named in Design.
the final-only malformed-argument tests (ACs 7-10, 12) are added here, reusing its `argumentsDelta`, `callEnd(arguments, argumentsError?)` and `done()` builders; no existing assertion changes.

analysis:
Goal and completion: fix review findings 8 and 9 inside the existing pi protocol adapter, delivering completed-item-only text without duplicating streamed deltas and rejecting malformed completed tool arguments when no non-empty argument accumulation exists. Exactly one implementation story, US-001, runs in packages/nax-ai with no dependencies; its completion is the 12 specified observable outcomes. This is a targeted bug fix, not a protocol redesign. Navigation used direct reads and targeted text searches because codebase-memory MCP tools are unavailable in this session.

Refinement audit against the spec: all 12 ACs remain in US-001 in spec order: (1) final-only text at protocol stream; (2) final-only text through public complete and an injected ProtocolFactory; (3) ordinary deltas exactly once, control; (4) missing suffix; (5) divergent completion leaves deltas alone, control; (6) independent text indexes; (7) malformed no-delta call suppressed; (8) terminal usage then exact bad-request details and provider error cause; (9) valid no-delta empty object, control; (10) parseable accumulated fallback, control; (11) shorter completion and empty final-only text emit nothing additional, control; (12) empty-string argument delta is not usable fallback for argumentsError. Control annotations and all qualifying conditions are retained. AC 2 clarifies the existing factory returns protocol entries rather than a bare Protocol, and complete returns a result with a text field rather than a bare string. Both failure-table rows map to ACs 5 and 8; ACs 7, 8, and 12 also provide negative-path coverage. All four spec context files are included, the fifth is the existing public-client catalog example, and the sole new test file is only in expectedFiles. All five feature exclusions are preserved verbatim and echoed in story scope. US-001 retains its binding workdir and empty dependencies; medium/tdd-simple remains appropriate for one runtime source file and two test files. No description contradicts an AC, and no new acceptance requirement or dependency was introduced.

Verified implementation: packages/nax-ai/src/protocols/pi-client.ts:411 defines createPiProtocol(name, deps), and its stream-scoped tool accumulator and malformedToolArgs state start at :421. The text_delta branch at :469 currently forwards only event.delta; text_end has no branch and is covered by the default comment at :598. Add a Map<number, string> local to each stream, append emitted deltas by contentIndex, and reconcile text_end against the emitted prefix. Emit only a strictly longer matching suffix; equal, divergent, shorter, and empty completed text contribute nothing further. Delete each index entry after text_end and do not flush unmatched entries from done, exhaustion, or exception paths. A per-index map avoids cross-block interference, while stream-local allocation avoids cross-request leakage.

Tool-argument failure path: packages/nax-ai/src/protocols/pi-client.ts:507 takes the pending accumulation, parses pending?.raw ?? empty string, and emits completedToolInput. packages/nax-ai/src/protocols/tool-args.ts:21 creates the accumulator, :37 removes an id on take, and :51 defines parseToolArgs, whose empty-string result is an empty object. An empty-string delta still creates a pending entry, so checking pending alone is insufficient. The new guard must check argumentsError !== undefined together with pending === undefined or pending.raw === empty string; it must retain the exact provider argumentsError string as the error cause. Set the existing malformedToolArgs state and break without a tool-call rather than throwing or yielding a premature error. The draining path at pi-client.ts:448 already consumes until done, emits terminal usage, then the stored bad-request error and returns without successful done. Its upstream-error, truncated-stream, and thrown-error handling at :609 and :620 must remain unchanged. Existing accumulated JSON parse failures must still fail even when the completed arguments object looks usable. completedToolInput at :337 trusts completed plain objects unless argumentsError is present; retain that precedence for all other cases. Update its preceding doc comment to distinguish non-empty parseable fallback from missing/empty accumulation, and update the default event comment at :598 to stop claiming text_end carries nothing expressible. Do not modify tool-args.ts.

Integration and dependencies: packages/nax-ai/src/protocols/pi-protocols.ts:103 defines defaultProtocols and dynamically imports createPiDeps/createPiProtocol at :109, so the internal mapper change reaches the existing pi-backed protocol registrations without registry edits. packages/nax-ai/src/protocols/error-response-fetch.ts:21 imports only the PiResponse type and requires no change. packages/nax-ai/src/client.ts:31 defines ProtocolFactory, :67 constructs the catalog/registry, :119 resolves the protocol and wraps its stream with transport retry, and :162 derives complete through collectStream. packages/nax-ai/src/protocols/collect.ts:71 collects text-delta text and :87 throws ProtocolStreamError on error after retaining usage; consequently corrected protocol events automatically repair public completion text and surface malformed arguments through the existing error contract. No changes to client, collector, registry, retry, provider catalogs, consumers, or public interfaces are needed. Any emitted event, including usage, continues to terminate retry eligibility. The mapper is shared by pi-backed protocols, so unchanged ordinary streaming and valid tool calls are important compatibility controls.

Tests and file ownership: packages/nax-ai/test/protocols/pi-client.test.ts:31 supplies fakePi, :452 supplies drain, and :459 is the ordinary he/llo/hello delta test whose existing title and assertions must remain untouched. This file currently has 984 lines and already exceeds the stated 800-line limit; do not expand it or import its exported helpers into the new test. Create packages/nax-ai/test/protocols/pi-client-final-text.test.ts with small local fakePi/message/text event builders and drain, covering ACs 1-6 and 11. For AC 2 inject a ProtocolFactory whose openai-responses pi entry returns createPiProtocol over the fake stream; model the local RawProvider catalog on packages/nax-ai/test/client.test.ts:6 and client construction/model resolution/completion on :35 and :69, aligning provider, model id, and defaultProtocol with openai-responses. Do not bypass the real public createClient.complete collection path or make network requests. Extend only packages/nax-ai/test/protocols/pi-client-final-args.test.ts for ACs 7-10 and 12, reusing argumentsDelta at :72, callEnd(arguments, argumentsError?) at :76, done at :91, and drain at :99. Existing fallback coverage at :213 already pins parseable accumulation with argumentsError; existing :238 verifies usage before bad-request while draining. Keep all existing assertions, including completed-object precedence, malformed-JSON rejection, and the real-pi/fake-fetch tests beginning at :258.

Test execution plan: use tdd-simple; first show new non-control ACs 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, and 12 fail against unchanged source, while controls 3, 5, 9, 10, and 11 pass. Then implement the narrow mapping changes and run targeted Vitest files followed by the package suite and normal package gates. From packages/nax-ai, bun run test -- test/protocols/pi-client-final-text.test.ts test/protocols/pi-client-final-args.test.ts test/protocols/pi-client.test.ts test/client.test.ts runs the focused tests; bun run test runs the package suite, bun run typecheck runs its current typecheck script, and bun run check:all runs its lint gates. Never use bare bun test or live-provider tests. This PRD drafting step did not execute tests or change implementation. Scripted events prove event mapping, not real-provider frequency or behavior; the upstream review's observations are spec-provided evidence, not newly reproduced production evidence.

Repository constraints and drift: packages/nax-ai/package.json:47 currently pins @earendil-works/pi-ai to 1.5.0 rather than the spec's 1.4.0 and :53 pins TypeScript 7.0.2; :27 currently maps typecheck to bun check. Preserve current dependencies and commands rather than downgrading to the review baseline. Confirm builders against the installed event types during implementation while retaining the required event semantics. Source remains Node >=22.19, ESM, explicit .ts imports, strict exact optional properties, no Bun runtime APIs, and no new pi-ai source import sites. Only pi-client.ts changes at runtime; two test files are added/extended. This work does not involve authentication or access-control behavior, so security-isolated TDD is unnecessary despite unrelated credential/header logic elsewhere in the adapter.

Risks and migration: prefix matching must use startsWith and a strict length check to avoid duplicate text or attempted retractions; missing map entries mean an empty emitted prefix, and entries must be removed even for divergent/empty completions. The arguments guard must distinguish absent argumentsError from an explicitly present error and absent accumulation from an empty recorded delta. Errors must preserve billed usage and exact error details rather than emit a successful empty tool call, and must not accidentally change valid no-delta empty-object calls or non-empty parseable fallback. Text buffering adds temporary per-stream memory proportional to active text blocks, released per text_end or when the stream is discarded. Public types and call sites remain unchanged; no data migration, consumer configuration migration, dependency changes, or release/version bump is required. The intentional compatibility change is that previously accepted malformed final-only tool calls now fail with the already established bad-request contract. No separate implementation seam is introduced.
